summary_en: Board authorized expansion of share buyback program from 275 million shares (2.38% of outstanding) and 11.0 billion yen to 325 million shares (2.84%) and 13.0 billion yen. Acquisition period remains May 13, 2026 to March 31, 2027, via market purchase on Tokyo Stock Exchange.
title_en: Notice Regarding Expansion of Share Acquisition Authorization
translation_en_brief: On November 6, 2026, the Board of Directors of COMSYS Holdings Corporation resolved to expand the company's share repurchase authorization. The maximum number of shares to be acquired was increased from 2.75 million to 3.25 million shares, representing 2.84% of outstanding shares (excluding treasury stock as of September 30, 2026). The maximum acquisition amount was raised from 11.0 billion yen to 13.0 billion yen. The acquisition method remains market purchase on the Tokyo Stock Exchange, with the acquisition period unchanged at May 13, 2026 through March 31, 2027. The company stated that the expansion is intended to improve capital efficiency and further enhance shareholder returns.
